r4e-numerical-faithfulness.title: Numerical faithfulness spot-check
r4e-numerical-faithfulness.imperative: matern52_sde P_inf, discretize Q=P_inf-Phi P_inf Phi^T, diffuse-diagonal init, linear detrend, affine-offset EKF, NS r==1 reduction all match lab.
r4e-numerical-faithfulness.finding: Direct comparison to lab e10_lib.py: (1) matern52_sde: F matrix [[0,1,0],[0,0,1],[-lam^3,-3lam^2,-3lam]], L=[0,0,1]^T, P_inf with v_f=sf2, v_fd=sf2*5/(3ell^2), v_fdd=sf2*25/ell^4, c_f_fdd=-sf2*5/(3ell^2) — EXACT match. (2) discretize: Q=P_inf-Phi@P_inf@Phi.T with symmetrization — EXACT match. (3) Diffuse diagonal init: P[0,0]=P[3,3]=1e6, P[1,1]=P[4,4]=1e4, acc marginal from Pinf, zero cross terms — EXACT match. (4) Linear detrend: np.polyfit(tp-tm, yX/yY, 1) with velocity add-back on query — EXACT match. (5) Affine-offset iterated-EKF speed update: spd0+jx*(mp[1]-xd0)+jy*(mp[4]-yd0) with affine pred_meas — EXACT match to e10_lib lines 250-254. (6) NSStintSmoother r==1 reduction: when t_drv=None, _r_at returns 1.0, Q=1.0*Q0_x=Q0_x, reducing to plain StintSmoother — correct. Implementer nesting smoke confirms 1.07e-14 max_diff.
